## What I did

Rewrote cmdDone in src/managent/main.zig to the two-phase pattern the brief prescribes:

- **Phase 1 (under lockStore):** read state → validate task is in_progress → attribution (agent) → deliverable git check (fast subprocesses) → reject empty --skip-acceptance reason (moved BEFORE the write, so a malformed skip never half-mutates the store) → set status=done + done timestamp + verdict (+ verdict_note, skip_acceptance_reason) → unblock dependents → writeStateLocked → explicit unlockStore().
- **Phase 2 (no lock):** run the acceptance command via /bin/sh -c. On ANY failure (spawn fault, 126/127, non-zero exit, signal, stopped, unknown) → revertAcceptanceFailure(): re-acquire flock → re-read → guard-check (status still .done AND done timestamp == the phase-1 write) → restore in_progress + the pre-mutation done/verdict/verdict_note → re-block dispatchable dependents whose needs are unmet again (symmetric inverse of phase-1 unblock) → writeStateLocked → unlock. Then print the failure detail + 'Task stays in_progress' and exit(1).
- --skip-acceptance path preserved: reason validated (non-empty when the acceptance branch applies) and recorded in phase 1; 'ACCEPTANCE SKIPPED' printed in phase 2, which then does nothing else.

Added `revertAcceptanceFailure` helper right after cmdDone. Added regression tools/regression-managent-done-two-phase.sh (7 controls, wired into zig build test after the lock regression).
